reason: Measured: loading has zero focusables, but so do phone and ended, the flagship guest states. That count is the read-only register, not a defect, and ended is itself a control-free dead end. What survives is real: driven for nine seconds the frame still says "Bringing in what is ahead" and stays aria-busy forever, with no terminal face. The lab already renders ended, an equally server-side condition, as a static frame, so a stalled-load frame is honest and buildable as a branch inside states.loading. The fix's timer and auto-focus are wrong.
sharpenedFix: Branch states.loading on a declared twelfth state, loading-slow, so it is shot and gated deterministically. No 8-second JS timer: that would make the loading shot flaky and untestable. Keep the reserved geometry, the real h1 name and the today line byte-identical so nothing hops between faces. Set aria-busy false and role="status" on the field; replace only the sub line. Render one .b-act "Try again" but do NOT auto-focus it, a control appearing unbidden and stealing focus is a class lessons.md already records. Match ended's voice: name the condition, then what is still true.
